keys: THROWAWAY TEST KEYS, made for these vectors only. No private key is stored. Never trust one.

vectors.name: p256/good
vectors.why: Signed in Python; PEM key, UTF-8 message, jsonEquals.

vectors.name: p256/good-decimals-in-signed-bytes
vectors.why: The signed text holds decimals as Python prints them (1.0, 1e-07). ADR-0045 section 2 allows them.

vectors.name: p256/good-binary-message-spki-base64
vectors.why: A base64 message that is not UTF-8, a base64 key, no jsonEquals.

vectors.name: p256/good-base64-message-jsonequals
vectors.why: A base64 message whose bytes are the JSON of the object.

vectors.name: p256/good-object-keys-in-another-order
vectors.why: jsonEquals ignores the order of object keys.

vectors.name: p256/good-pem-crlf-no-final-line-end
vectors.why: PEM lines may end in CRLF, and the final line end is optional.

vectors.name: p256/wrong-key-in-delivery
vectors.why: Another key and its own valid signature. The terms pin a different fingerprint.

expect.detail: publicKey: fingerprint differs from the terms

vectors.name: p256/wrong-key-signed
vectors.why: The pinned key is delivered, but another key signed.

vectors.name: p256/flipped-byte-message
vectors.why: One byte of the signed text changed after signing.

vectors.name: p256/flipped-byte-signature
vectors.why: One bit of the signature's last byte changed.

vectors.name: p256/flipped-byte-public-key
vectors.why: One bit of the delivered key changed. The fingerprint is compared before any curve arithmetic.

expect.detail: publicKey: fingerprint differs from the terms

vectors.name: p256/random-signature-bytes
vectors.why: 64 random bytes in place of the signature, in the check's usual format.

vectors.name: p256/float-respelled-after-signing
vectors.why: Signed 1.0, delivered as 1 (what a JavaScript re-serialization writes). The bytes differ.

vectors.name: p256/float-introduced-after-signing
vectors.why: Signed the integer 3, delivered as 3.0. The bytes differ.

vectors.name: p256/float-in-object-signed-integer
vectors.why: The signed text says 3; the object the other checks read says 3.5.

expect.detail: message: differs from the value at jsonEquals

vectors.name: p256/float-spelling-equal-under-jsonequals
vectors.why: Signed 1.0, object 1: the same number, so jsonEquals holds (ADR-0045 section 3).

vectors.name: p256/float-in-check-parameters
vectors.why: A float in place of a pointer. The check is part of the hashed terms, so no number enters it (ADR-0022).

vectors.name: p256/oversize-public-key
vectors.why: A key string of 1,025 characters.

vectors.name: p256/oversize-public-key-boundary
vectors.why: A key string of 1,024 characters passes the length limit and fails to decode.

expect.detail: publicKey: not a PEM public key

vectors.name: p256/oversize-signature
vectors.why: A signature string of 257 characters.

vectors.name: p256/oversize-signature-boundary
vectors.why: A signature string of 256 characters passes the length limit and decodes to too many bytes.

vectors.name: p256/oversize-pointer
vectors.why: A pointer of 513 characters in the check.

vectors.name: p256/unknown-algorithm
vectors.why: An algorithm outside the closed list. Refused at offer time; it never passes.

vectors.name: p256/wrong-algorithm-for-the-key
vectors.why: The check names the other algorithm, with this key pinned.

vectors.name: p256/good-raw-signature
vectors.why: r then s in 64 bytes.

vectors.name: p256/good-high-s
vectors.why: A high s is accepted. A verifier that requires a low s fails this vector.

vectors.name: p256/good-raw-high-s
vectors.why: A high s in the raw form.

vectors.name: p256/random-signature-bytes-raw
vectors.why: 64 random bytes in the raw form.

vectors.name: p256/raw-signature-in-der-check
vectors.why: A valid raw signature in a `der` check. A verifier that guesses the format passes it by mistake.

vectors.name: p256/der-signature-in-raw-check
vectors.why: A DER signature in a `raw` check.

vectors.name: p256/good-64-byte-der
vectors.why: A valid DER signature of exactly 64 bytes, under a key built for it. The control for the next vector.

vectors.name: p256/64-byte-der-in-raw-check
vectors.why: The same signature in a `raw` check is r then s, and does not verify. A verifier that names no format passes it.

vectors.name: p256/der-empty-integers
vectors.why: A DER SEQUENCE of two empty INTEGERs. DER has no empty INTEGER.

vectors.name: p256/der-trailing-byte
vectors.why: One byte after the DER signature (at most 72 bytes in all).

vectors.name: p256/der-over-72-bytes
vectors.why: 73 bytes in a `der` check.

vectors.name: p256/r-zero
vectors.why: r is 0.

vectors.name: p256/s-zero
vectors.why: s is 0.

vectors.name: p256/r-is-the-order
vectors.why: r is the curve order.

vectors.name: p256/s-is-the-order
vectors.why: s is the curve order.

vectors.name: p256/compressed-point
vectors.why: The same key with a compressed point, pinned by its own fingerprint.

vectors.name: p256/point-not-on-the-curve
vectors.why: The right shape and the pinned fingerprint, with a point that is not on P-256.

vectors.name: p256/delivery-not-json
vectors.why: A CSV delivery.

vectors.name: p256/publicKey-pointer-to-nothing
vectors.why: The document has no `pubkey`.

vectors.name: p256/publicKey-not-a-string
vectors.why: `pubkey` is a number.

vectors.name: p256/message-pointer-to-nothing
vectors.why: The document has no `manifest_text`.

vectors.name: p256/message-not-a-string
vectors.why: `manifest_text` is a number.

vectors.name: p256/signature-pointer-to-nothing
vectors.why: The document has no `manifest_sig`.

vectors.name: p256/signature-not-a-string
vectors.why: `manifest_sig` is a number.

vectors.name: p256/pointer-to-an-inherited-property
vectors.why: A pointer reads the document's own members only.

vectors.name: p256/pointer-not-rfc6901
vectors.why: A pointer with no leading slash.

vectors.name: p256/ed25519-with-der
vectors.why: `ed25519` takes the `raw` format only.

vectors.name: p256/extra-property
vectors.why: The check's objects are closed.

vectors.name: p256/check-id-outside-the-pattern
vectors.why: A check id follows the schema's pattern.

vectors.why: Text before the PEM block.

vectors.why: A base64 key with a final line end.

vectors.why: Base64 with a space.

vectors.name: p256/signature-base64-no-padding
vectors.why: Base64 without padding.

vectors.name: p256/signature-base64-url-alphabet
vectors.why: The URL alphabet.

vectors.name: p256/signature-base64-trailing-bits
vectors.why: Non-zero trailing bits: a second spelling of the same bytes.

vectors.name: p256/message-base64-no-padding
vectors.why: A base64 message without padding.

vectors.name: p256/message-lone-surrogate
vectors.why: A lone surrogate has no UTF-8 encoding. The signature covers U+FFFD, which a lenient encoder puts in its place.

vectors.name: p256/signed-bytes-not-json
vectors.why: A good signature over text that is not JSON, in a check with jsonEquals.

vectors.name: p256/signed-bytes-with-a-byte-order-mark
vectors.why: A good signature over JSON after a byte order mark, with jsonEquals. See README, open questions.

vectors.name: p256/jsonequals-pointer-to-nothing
vectors.why: Nothing sits at the jsonEquals pointer. See README, open questions.
